item.title: Patch now: Actively Exploited OS Command Injection in Juniper Session Smart Conductor
item.description:
Juniper Session Smart Conductor: RCE · exploited · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for Juniper Session Smart Conductor. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

High · Fix available
